work_context.location_limits: Lisbon, Portugal; 3 days per week in the office. No country, time-zone, relocation, or right-to-work limits stated.
culture_signals: Values: Together (share context openly and help across teams), Ownership (own, fix and learn from problems), and Pace (cut unnecessary complexity to move quickly for clients).
Collaborative environment; teamwork and personal development come first.
The company describes a commercially driven culture with friendly colleagues; reviewers say onboarding and training vary considerably between teams.
Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how the company builds connections.
work_context.notes: The job ad specifies hybrid work in Lisbon with 3 office days per week. The company results say most offices use the same 3-day hybrid pattern and describe the Lisbon office as hybrid, so there is no stated difference.
